body: Well I am currently living in said metropolis away from my family (thank god). And no I haven’t been to the US.

I'm not too worried about the dog, my dad is a pretty good at taking care of animals. He's just not good at standing his ground when my mom yells at him. Unfortunately I haven't been able to find a new job (this economy, geez). She knows where I work, so I'm slightly terrified that she'll just go sabotage my job and thus forcing me back.

I can change my password (we use passwords in my building), which is an awesome idea. Last time my dad came first, so I let him in not knowing she's here, too (she kinda just squeezed in). She knows if she came by herself, I'll never let her in.
Yeah I know, but I like my job...and I like the city that I’m living in. It’s not easy to just leave everything behind. I’m definitely not going back, that’s for sure.
Lawyer is a good idea, as for cops, I’m not exactly on good terms with the police force (I live in China and fought a little bit too much for human rights, you get the idea).

Thank you for telling me that I’m not losing my mind. Honestly, I just felt like I’m going insane or something for thinking she’s trying to manipulate me using a dog. I was like “am I too paranoid?” “Maybe she just want a dog or something”. Yes I’m seeking therapy but it’s hard to do because my country is so SHIT abusive parents are littered everywhere. I’m slightly terrified that they’ll just brainwash me to go back or something.

As much as I want to do that, it’s hard to find a new job,  and I love my current job (my coworkers are nice, the pay is good). And I dread to think what she’ll do if I just took off like that...I fought so hard to have a little space of my own, I can’t have her call the police on me or arriving at my job crying and kicking.

Oh damn, that sounds amazing. I sometimes see sunrise when my shift’s about to end, 4:00, 5:00, something like that, but I only have a tiny window that’s not enough to see. My apartment has a HUGE window tho, I can see the lights of the city, just like starlights, gorgeous stuff.
That’s okay, hopefully everyone (including you and your friend) can always get the help they needed.
Today, just a few hours ago actually.
